name: gl-zoom-in-out
title: ZoomInOut transition
description: Zooms into the outgoing image until it blurs into a flat color, then out to the incoming one. Load vendor/glintmotion/hyper-shader.js, then this file, then call HyperShader.init({ transitions: [{ time, shader: "gl-zoom-in-out", duration }] }).
